fieldNotes.truckGate: Clear checkpoint with painted striped lane markings (pinch-point) on the SE access drive; a vehicle is stopped at it in z21 imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small light-coloured booth sits right at the striped checkpoint with a car parked beside it — a staffed guard booth, not the main building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Cross-dock RDC: dock doors run along both long faces of the building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long wooded approach from Campanelli Drive to the gate; deep internal yard gives 3+ truck stacking room.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Gate set far back from the public road behind a long wooded drive — a queue would not reach Campanelli Drive.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park surrounded by woodland on the outskirts of Westfield; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer drop yard at the SW end holds ~95 trailers visible; band estimated from overhead imagery.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows at the SW corner of the property, separate from the dock aprons.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single inbound lane at the checkpoint; exit shares the same gate group.
